name: GAvatar
aliases: GAvatar — A text-based generation method using primitive-based representation attached to SMPL-X and 3D Gaussians
definition: A text-based generation method using primitive-based representation attached to SMPL-X and 3D Gaussians.
summary: GAvatar generates animatable 3D human avatars from text by binding 3D Gaussians to SMPL-X primitives and using NeuS-like SDF conversion for detailed mesh extraction.
